durations_source: per-test durations of the not-rare, not-slow, not-serial tier at ad2e0300 (-n 8, line-coverage tracing on; an upper bound)

smoke.collect_command: CI=true OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 TORCHLENS_ORACLE_ENFORCE=1 python -m pytest --collect-only -q -o addopts= -p no:randomly -p no:cacheprovider -m "smoke" tests/

mid.collect_command: CI=true OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 TORCHLENS_ORACLE_ENFORCE=1 python -m pytest --collect-only -q -o addopts= -p no:randomly -p no:cacheprovider -m "not rare and not slow and not heavy" tests/

not_slow.collect_command: CI=true OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 TORCHLENS_ORACLE_ENFORCE=1 python -m pytest --collect-only -q -o addopts= -p no:randomly -p no:cacheprovider -m "not rare and not slow" tests/

all.collect_command: CI=true OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 TORCHLENS_ORACLE_ENFORCE=1 python -m pytest --collect-only -q -o addopts= -p no:randomly -p no:cacheprovider tests/
